title: Quality control issues with masher, Separator is great!
text:
Quality control issues with masher, Separator is great!. Five stars for the separator/1.5 stars for masher that arrived with what looked like road rash. Really wanted to love this. The design itself is great for the separator and not the greatest for the masher. The separator is easy to take apart, wash in the dishwasher and reassembled easily. The masher, though not used was run through the washer twice and the black spot nor indentations still will not come off. I’m sending it back. The ball handle fits well in the hand, but the handle collects water from the washer, so you may want to wash yours by hand, as bacteria will grow in there otherwise then drip onto your food the next time you use it. I also think it should be taller for a deeper pot of potatoes, most of my mashers are at least 4 inches taller.

Not sure about the durability.
